clauses.requirement: For each lamp type, the type approval holder shall carry out at least the tests of Annex 4 para 2 at appropriate intervals, in accordance with this Regulation; if any sampling shows non-conformity for a test, further samples shall be taken and tested, and the manufacturer shall ensure conformity of production; the conformity tests shall cover the photometric and colorimetric characteristics.

The methods used in the manufacturer's conformity tests shall comply with the provisions of Annex 4 para 2.2 (subparagraphs 2.2.1 to 2.2.4), under the minimum verification requirements of Annex 4 para 2.
Conformity tests by the manufacturer shall generally be carried out in accordance with the test methods set out in this Regulation.

Equivalent test methods may be used in the manufacturer's conformity tests only with the consent of the competent authority responsible for approval tests; the manufacturer shall prove that the applied methods are equivalent to those laid down in this Regulation.

Where the test methods of paras 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 are applied (this Regulation's methods or authority-approved equivalent methods), the manufacturer shall ensure regular calibration of test apparatus and its correlation with measurements made by a competent authority.
In all cases the reference test methods shall be those of this Regulation, particularly for administrative verification and sampling.

Lamp samples for conformity verification shall be selected at random from the production of a uniform batch (a set of lamps of the same type defined by the manufacturer's production methods); the assessment shall generally cover series production of individual factories, but the manufacturer may group records for the same type from several factories provided they operate under the same quality system and quality management.
Each sampled lamp shall be subjected to photometric measurements of the minimum values at the points listed in Annex 3, and the required chromaticity coordinates shall be measured and recorded.
